categories.main_business_segments: DraftKings operates primarily in two main business segments: Sportsbook (online and retail sports betting) and iGaming (online casino). These two segments accounted for over 90% of total revenues in recent years. Additional offerings include daily fantasy sports (DFS), digital lottery courier services, and media/advertising solutions. The company also previously operated an NFT marketplace, which was discontinued in 2024.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: DraftKings leverages proprietary and third-party software platforms, integrating account management, regulatory compliance, and payment processing into a unified user experience. The company employs data science and machine learning for personalization, fraud detection, and operational efficiency. Its iGaming platform combines in-house developed games with licensed content from major suppliers, while its Sportsbook uses algorithmic and manual odds-setting supported by real-time data feeds.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DraftKings serves individual consumers who are sports fans and gaming enthusiasts, primarily targeting adults interested in real-money online sports betting, casino gaming, and fantasy sports. Its customer base spans casual players to high-frequency bettors, with a focus on the U.S. market and select international jurisdictions. The company also partners with advertisers and media brands for its media and sponsorship offerings.
categories.geographic_coverage: DraftKings operates in 26 U.S. states and the District of Columbia for online sports betting, with iGaming available in six U.S. states and Ontario, Canada. Its DFS product is accessible in 44 U.S. states, D.C., and parts of Canada. The company maintains offices and technology teams in the U.S., Ireland, Bulgaria, Ukraine, Israel, and the UK, and continues to expand as new jurisdictions legalize online gaming.
categories.supply_chain_position: DraftKings is a downstream, consumer-facing operator in the gaming and entertainment supply chain. It acts as the platform and service provider directly engaging end users, while relying on upstream partners for game content, data feeds, payment processing, and market access agreements with casinos and other license holders.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, DraftKings prioritizes expanding its product offerings, entering new jurisdictions as regulations allow, and achieving scalable, predictable unit economics. The company invests heavily in technology, data science, and user experience innovation, with ongoing R&D in personalization, responsible gaming, and cross-product integration. Recent acquisitions (e.g., Jackpocket, Simplebet) reflect a focus on broadening its digital gaming ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: DraftKings generates revenue primarily through gross gaming revenue (hold) from Sportsbook and iGaming, where it retains the difference between user wagers and payouts. DFS revenue comes from entry fees minus prizes. Additional revenue streams include service fees and commissions from digital lottery courier operations, as well as advertising and sponsorship packages sold to brands and media partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DraftKings competes with other major online gaming and sports betting operators such as FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, and Bet365, as well as traditional entertainment options like casinos and sports media. The company is recognized as a market leader in U.S. online sports betting and iGaming, with a strong brand, technology platform, and national reach, but faces intense competition and ongoing industry consolidation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, DraftKings reported $4.77 billion in revenue, up 30% from $3.67 billion in 2023, with average monthly unique payers reaching 3.7 million. The company has demonstrated rapid revenue growth and user expansion, though it remains unprofitable on a net income basis, reporting a net loss of $507 million in 2024. Adjusted EBITDA turned positive in 2024, reflecting improving operating leverage as the business scales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DraftKings differentiates itself through a comprehensive, integrated digital gaming platform offering seamless cross-product experiences, a trusted brand, and a focus on responsible gaming. Its proprietary technology enables rapid innovation, personalized user engagement, and efficient market entry. The company emphasizes user experience, regulatory compliance, and a broad product suite to attract and retain a large, engaged customer base.
